title: Ultraviolette F77 Shadow Tech (Circuit Spec)
description: The Ultraviolette Automotive Ultraviolette F77 Shadow Tech (Circuit Spec) is tailored for aggressive twisties and sharp canyon transitions, positioned in the Performance Electric Sportbike segment for riders demanding engaging everyday dynamics. Its tuned powertrain delivers immediate, tractable torque against a curb weight of 108 kg, ensuring responsive roll-on acceleration in demanding road conditions. The cockpit is configured with an Aggressive Forward Tuck riding stance and a balanced 820mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort, making daily city navigation as intuitive as weekend backroad escapes.
